snippet.title: FACTOMANCER - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3979570/Factomancer/
（or search 👉"Factomancer"）

Welcome to Factomancer, an automation roguelite adventure where magic powers industry.
Every decision counts: build, automate, optimize… and adapt to the unexpected!

We are Voltige Games, an indie studio from Lyon, France. After a year of crafting and testing, our debut game is finally ready to be revealed.

🎮JOIN OUR COMMUNITY: https://discord.gg/HrZSJjzDkq

#IndieGame #Automation #Roguelite #Factomancer #VoltigeGames
